title: C compress gate lacks IPv6 address policy; emits Rule255 that Python peers fatal on
description: P1, found by correctness+security codereview passes of project-LICHEN-worker6-hahk (both independent reviewers converged with probe evidence). lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc.c:557 gates compress via validate_ipv6_transport_lengths only, which performs zero address checks. Python validate_full_ipv6 enforces _validate_ipv6_addresses (python/src/lichen/schc/headers.py:83-88, RX-enforced) and Rust enforces address policy on TX (rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs:241-263). Empirical: C accepts rule=255 for src ff02::1, src ::, dst :: (valid UDP checksums) while Python raises SchcError invalid IPv6 source/destination address for the same bytes - the exact blackhole shape bead hahk closed (C emits Rule255 datagrams a Python peer fatals on at ingress decode_rule255). Rules 0-7 reject these (scope checks, rule7 via validate_rule7_addresses) so emission is via the fallback path. Fix: mirror the P/R address policy at the schc.c gate (src unspecified/multicast; dst unspecified at minimum, matching Python RX contract; loopback/v4mapped/multicast-scope for full TX parity with Rust validate_address_policy), then pin with shared malformed vectors (mcast_src, unspecified_src, unspecified_dst) and rerun scripts/check-schc-compression-parity.py. Note Python also enforces emission-only checks (_validate_rule255_emission_endpoints headers.py:162-177: loopback/v4mapped src+dst, mcast scope 2-14) that C lacks - fold into the same fix for full TX parity. Probe artifacts: /tmp/opencode/hahk-schc-gate/review2/.
